summary: The United States continues a precise naval blockade of Iran while CENTCOM releases imagery of 82nd Airborne Division exercises, signaling sustained military pressure. Israel conducted a drone strike on Ali al-Taher Hill in southern Lebanon and refuses to withdraw from its current positions in Gaza. President Trump announced new talks with Iran beginning Monday, asserting a deal on the Strait of Hormuz exists and denuclearization will follow.
key_points: US Central Command reports forces continuing precise naval blockade against Iran (Source: @rodast_omiddana/78645)
Israeli drone targets Ali al-Taher Hill in southern Lebanon (Source: @presstv/201437)
Political source states Israel will not withdraw from current line in Gaza Strip (Source: @inon_yttach/9797)
Trump announces new talks with Iran starting Monday, says Hormuz deal exists and denuclearization will follow (Source: @VahidOnline/77711)
IRGC Ground Forces commander threatens to turn land into graveyard for terrorist elements (Source: @SharghDaily/176054)
Lebanese army walks back claim of Israeli strike, says explosion from suspicious object wounded five soldiers (Source: @manniefabian/58914)

sections.executive_summary: The United States continues a precise naval blockade of Iran while CENTCOM releases imagery of 82nd Airborne Division exercises, signaling sustained military pressure. Israel conducted a drone strike on Ali al-Taher Hill in southern Lebanon and refuses to withdraw from its current positions in Gaza. President Trump announced new talks with Iran beginning Monday, asserting a deal on the Strait of Hormuz exists and denuclearization will follow.

points: IRGC Ground Forces commander Brigadier General Mohammad Karami warned that any miscalculation by terrorist groups will turn Iranian territory into a graveyard for mercenary elements, emphasizing readiness of Hamza Sayyid al-Shuhada base under supreme commander's orders (Source: @SharghDaily/176054).

Iran announced the execution of two citizens, Amid Behzad and Pouria Sefat, convicted of spying for Israel during the recent war; one was described as a "Netanyahu soldier" who provided intelligence to Iran International (Source: @asafroz/52210).

Iranian Foreign Ministry spokesman Esmaeil Baghaei stated talks with Oman regarding the Strait of Hormuz are bilateral contacts to determine a safe shipping route, not negotiations with the United States (Source: @yediotnews25/133542).

Reuters reports Tehran leaders believe Trump's military threats are primarily to strengthen his negotiating position rather than initiate wider conflict, while US Central Command confirms continued precise naval blockade execution (Source: @rodast_omiddana/78647, @rodast_omiddana/78645).
CENTCOM released imagery of 82nd Airborne Division paratrooper exercises, described as indicating ground assault preparations more serious than previous drills (Source: @rodast_omiddana/78638).

President Trump declared the Strait of Hormuz under full US Navy control, stating nothing enters Iran without US permission unless a deal or total surrender is achieved, and Iran will never obtain a nuclear weapon (Source: @amitsegal/63606, @shin_persian/8799).
Netanyahu claimed nearly 85% of Iranians support Israeli attacks on the regime and respect him personally, citing unspecified statistics (Source: @rodast_omiddana/78639).

IDF announced a planned naval exercise from Monday morning through Tuesday evening in the maritime space between Shavei Zion and Ashdod, with active security forces and vessel movement expected (Source: @idf_telegram/24812).

Defense Minister Israel Katz publicly denounced Central Command chief Maj. Gen. Avi Bluth and announced his replacement on live television after over two years in the role, citing policy to promote commanders with proven aggressiveness in the Iron Swords War (Source: @manniefabian/58916).

Sources close to Katz escalated conflict with Chief of Staff Eyal Zamir over Bluth's replacement, alleging Zamir pushed Maj. Gen. Dado Bar Kalifa's appointment to prevent Netanyahu from selecting him as military secretary (Source: @N12chat/220475).
Netanyahu informed the High Court of plans to appoint an Interior Minister during the election period (Source: @amitsegal/63602).
Artillery fire by IDF forces in the Ramim Ridge area may be heard, according to a reporter on the scene (Source: @New_security8200/203161).
Red alert issued for warplane activity in southern Israel with maximum caution advised (Source: @redlinkleb/34596).
Residents in the confrontation line reported interceptions and projectiles fired from fighter jets (Source: @pkpoi/143502).

A political source stated Israel will not withdraw from its current line in the Gaza Strip and will continue to thwart any threat to civilians and soldiers (Source: @inon_yttach/9797, @New_security8200/203165).

Suspected kidnapping in Samaria: an Israeli vehicle with an 8-year-old girl was stolen near Nabi Elias and driven into Azzun area; IDF deployed forces, girl found in Nabi Elias after suspect threw her from vehicle, reunited with Arab-Israeli mother; manhunt ongoing (Source: @New_security8200/203170).
Israeli drone targeted Ali al-Taher Hill in southern Lebanon (Source: @presstv/201437).

Lebanese army retracted its claim that Israeli military struck its soldiers, determining an explosion that lightly wounded five soldiers was caused by a suspicious object (Source: @manniefabian/58914).
A tanker carrying two million barrels of Iraqi oil transited the Strait of Hormuz en route to China (Source: @naya_foriraq/86817).

UAE reportedly ordered six advanced Hermes 900 drones (known as Kochav in IDF) from Elbit Systems and 6,000 guided bomb kits under project "Yasmin 3" for delivery within three months, per Haaretz documents (Source: @SharghDaily/176061).
Oman hosts bilateral talks with Iran on Strait of Hormuz safe shipping routes, separate from US-Iran negotiations (Source: @yediotnews25/133542).

Global oil prices fell over 5% after Trump announced halt to military strikes on Iran and new talks, with markets citing reduced conflict probability and Hormuz closure concerns (Source: @VahidOnline/77713).
US Strategic Petroleum Reserve dropped to lowest level since 1983 per Reuters (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/382700, @presstv/201434).
Trump asserted Strait of Hormuz under complete US Navy control and "Wall of Steel" blockade, nothing passes to Iran without US consent (Source: @lelotsenzura/94049, @shin_persian/8799).

key_developments: US Central Command continues precise naval blockade of Iran while releasing 82nd Airborne Division exercise imagery indicating serious ground assault preparations (Source: @rodast_omiddana/78645, @rodast_omiddana/78638)
Israeli drone strikes Ali al-Taher Hill in southern Lebanon as Lebanese army retracts claim of Israeli strike on its soldiers (Source: @presstv/201437, @manniefabian/58914)
Israel refuses withdrawal from current Gaza positions, continues threat thwarting operations (Source: @inon_yttach/9797)
Trump announces new Iran talks starting Monday, claims Hormuz deal exists and denuclearization will follow (Source: @VahidOnline/77711)
UAE orders six Hermes 900 drones and 6,000 guided bomb kits from Israel per Haaretz documents (Source: @SharghDaily/176061)
Iran executes two alleged spies for Israel, including one linked to Iran International (Source: @asafroz/52210)
Suspected kidnapping attempt in Samaria foiled, girl recovered, manhunt underway (Source: @New_security8200/203170)
sections.threat_assessment: The concurrent US naval blockade, CENTCOM airborne exercises, and Israeli strikes indicate a coordinated pressure campaign against Iran while diplomatic talks are initiated. Iran's execution of alleged spies and IRGC threats suggest internal consolidation and deterrence signaling. Israel's refusal to withdraw from Gaza and leadership turmoil over military appointments reflect operational continuity amid political friction. The UAE's procurement of Israeli drones and munitions signals deepening military integration among US-aligned Gulf states. The kidnapping attempt in Samaria highlights persistent West Bank instability.
sections.regional_response: Oman facilitates bilateral Iran-Hormuz talks separate from US track, while Pakistan engages Iran diplomatically. Gulf markets react positively to reduced conflict probability, with oil prices dropping significantly. Lebanese army de-escalates by retracting strike claim, attributing explosion to suspicious object. Iraqi oil exports continue through Hormuz unimpeded. Azerbaijan-Iran border fire prompts cross-border coordination requests.
sections.intelligence_notes: Trump's public assertion of total Hormuz control and "Wall of Steel" blockade serves as strategic messaging to both Tehran and allies. Netanyahu's claim of 85% Iranian public support for Israeli attacks appears designed for domestic Iranian audience. The IDF naval exercise near Haifa-Ashtod corridor may signal readiness for maritime contingencies. CENTCOM's release of 82nd Airborne imagery is a deliberate signal of ground force readiness. The Defense Minister-Chief of Staff conflict over Central Command appointment reflects deeper civil-military tensions.
